caption_L1: Mexico 's exports of tequila from 1995 to 2019 (in million liters) is a line graph. The x-axis shows Year while the y-axis shows Exports in million liters.
caption_L2L3: Over 4 times as much tequila is exported from Mexico in 2019 compared to 1995. There has been a general increase in sales most years, except for 2006-2007 when it decreased slightly, and 2007-2009 when it stayed relatively stable. The rate of increase has been greatest between 2018 and 2019.
